comparison.objective: Reset tongue-and-groove pliers from the narrowest to the widest groove and leave them locked.
comparison.physical_skill: Open past a release angle, translate a slip joint along its slot, then close it into a discrete groove.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires groove 5 locked, pliers flat and still, and hands clear for one second; intermediate grooves receive partial credit.
comparison.reason: Although both change and retain an opening, this record tests release-angle-gated sliding into a discrete groove, while the candidate tests continuous screw adjustment preserved through jam-nut countertorque and three functional cycles.
